SUMMARY: 🚴‍♂️🏕️ Poudre River Trail Overnight Bike Tour: Greeley to Fort Collins & Back
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
Join me for our first overnight bike touring adventure on **Saturday, November 7–Sunday, November 8, 2026!**
We’ll ride from **Greeley to Fort Collins along the 🚲 [Poudre River Trail](https://poudretrail.org/maps/)**, camp overnight at **🏕️ [Fort Collins Lakeside KOA](https://koa.com/campgrounds/fort-collins-lakeside/)**, and ride back the following day. Enjoy time outdoors with friends and experience carrying your camping gear by bike!
I’ve reserved a **group campsite** for us!

📅 **Trip Details**

* **Dates:** Saturday, November 7–Sunday, November 8
* **Starting location:** Greeley—exact meeting point and overnight parking details to come
* **Meeting and departure time:** To be announced
* **Camping:** 🏕️ [Fort Collins Lakeside KOA](https://koa.com/campgrounds/fort-collins-lakeside/)
* **Saturday distance:** Approximately **41–51 miles**, depending on your riding option
* **Sunday distance:** Approximately **41 miles**
* **Weekend total:** Approximately **82–92 miles**

🚲 **The Ride**
Our route follows the paved [Poudre River Trail](https://poudretrail.org/maps/), with a short road connection to the campground. We’ll carry our own clothing, camping gear, and supplies.
This is a social touring trip, with stops to regroup, rest, eat, and enjoy the scenery. You should be comfortable riding **40+ miles per day while carrying your gear**.
🏕️ **Saturday: Three Riding Options**

* **Option 1: Head straight to camp—approximately 41 miles.** Set up your tent and relax.
* **Option 2: Ride to the trail’s end, then return to camp—approximately 50 miles.** Complete the longer ride with your gear.
* **Option 3: Drop off your gear, then continue—approximately 50–51 miles total.** Unload your panniers at KOA, then ride to the trail’s end and back with a lighter bike, depending on check-in availability.

🌅 **Sunday: Return to Greeley**
After breakfast, we’ll pack up camp and ride approximately **41 miles back to our starting point in Greeley**.
🚴 **Bikes & Carrying Your Gear**
Touring, gravel, hybrid, and road bikes are suitable for the paved route, provided they can safely carry your overnight equipment.
If you own a **hybrid or gravel bike**, a compatible removable rack and panniers can help you carry your gear. [Old Man Mountain](https://oldmanmountain.com/) is one option to explore—check compatibility with your bike before purchasing.
You don’t need a dedicated touring bike, but please make sure your bike is in good working condition and test your loaded setup before the trip.
🎒 **What to Bring**

* Bike and helmet
* Rack and panniers or securely attached bikepacking bags
* Tent, sleeping bag, and sleeping pad suitable for November temperatures
* Warm layers, gloves, and weather protection
* Water, riding snacks, and food for your overnight stay
* Spare tube, pump, tire levers, and basic repair tools
* Front and rear bike lights
* Phone charger and charging cable—the campsite has electricity

🍽️ **Food & Camping**
Bring enough food and snacks to be self-sufficient. We can coordinate meals closer to the trip. The campground is near town, so we can also head into Fort Collins to grab a meal together.
🚗 **Transportation & Parking**
We’ll start and finish in Greeley. Exact parking details will be shared once overnight parking is confirmed.
Please comment if you’re interested in carpooling and whether you can transport another rider and their bike.
⚠️ **Please Keep in Mind**
This is a **self-supported trip with no support vehicle**. Everyone is responsible for carrying their equipment and being prepared for the riding distance.
Looking forward to our first overnight bike tour together! 🚴‍♂️🏕️

SUMMARY: Running Group - Belleview Elementary School and Cherry Creek State Park
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
**When and where**
We **leave** the Belleview Elementary School parking lot at **5:45 PM**, so please try to arrive a few minutes before then. If you are running late or can't find us, leave a comment or send a DM!

**Pace and distance**
Our typical run is around 4.5 miles at a steady 9-11:00 minute/mile pace. However, this varies depending on who shows up!

**Group size**
We usually have around 5-10 people attend, depending on the weather and season. Many of us have been coming for years; some people come every week, while others come less frequently.

**About us**
This is a small, dedicated running group that's been meeting consistently for several years (formerly under Colorado Runs). We're a friendly, tight-knit group that welcomes new members who are looking to make friends, train for races, or find consistent running partners.

Come join us if this sounds like a good fit for your running goals! We look forward to meeting you!

SUMMARY: 🃏 EUCHRE NIGHT: Play the Midwest's Favorite Card Game!
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
Missing your Buffalo, NY roots? Feeling nostalgic for the Midwest? Or have absolutely no idea what a ***left bower*** is, but want to find out?

**Then pull up a chair—Euchre Night is for you!**
Join us for a casual evening of cards, drinks, friendly competition, and questionable strategic decisions to celebrate the beloved card game that Midwesterners have been aggressively teaching their friends/family for years. This event will be held at 📍\*\*[Schoolyard Beer Garden](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZM9fHLM676DhYMft9)\*\* in the indoor seating area. There is usually free street parking or low-cost lot parking, and no pressure if you need to leave before 9:00 PM. We sometimes go until 9:30 if things get competitive!

**Never played before? No problem!** Beginners are absolutely welcome, and we'll teach you everything you need to know—from "trump" and "bowers" to why someone just looked personally offended when you didn't follow suit ("reneging").
Already a Euchre pro? Come find your people, grab a partner, and show us what you've got!
We often rotate tables and partners throughout the evening so you'll have opportunities to meet new people, play a few hands, and perhaps discover your new favorite card-game rival.

👉 Click **[here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GUPr8U3iXA8)** for a euchre overview/intro

🏆 **And stay tuned!** As our Euchre community grows, we may occasionally shake things up with friendly, low-stakes tournaments, prizes, and other special events.
**Come for the cards. Stay for the camaraderie. Leave arguing about whether you should have called trump.** 🃏🍺

*PLEASE NOTE:* Euchre is played in groups of 4, so we need at least 4 participants per event to avoid canceling. The venue location may be subject to change and event dates may be adjusted once the Buffalo Bills' regular season begins. Bills Mafia for life! 🦬
